description:
DEMO. Save a car search and get alerted when new cars match. Returns a search_id (keep it; it is the only way to
read or cancel the search) and an expiry (default 30 days, renewable). Check for new cars with get_new_matches, or
give a callback_url. Shopper email alerts are optional and need explicit consent. On this demo, email sending is
switched off (alerts are logged, not sent) and new arrivals are simulated.

callback_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook for new matches. Public addresses only; HMAC-signed (X-MoonshotLab-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.<body>'>).
callback_url.title: Callback Url

credit_tier.description: excellent, good, fair or poor, for the payment estimate.
credit_tier.title: Credit Tier

down_payment.description: Down payment used for the payment estimate, USD.
down_payment.title: Down Payment

email_consent.description: true only if the shopper explicitly agreed to alert emails.
email_consent.title: Email Consent

expires_in_days.description: Days until the search ends (default 30, max 90). Renew any time.
expires_in_days.title: Expires In Days

renew_search_id.description: Pass an existing search_id to renew it instead of saving a new one.
renew_search_id.title: Renew Search Id

shopper_email.description: Optional: shopper's email for alert emails. Only with email_consent=true after the shopper agreed. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe.
shopper_email.title: Shopper Email

state.description: Two-letter state of the selling store.
state.title: State

term_months.description: Loan term for the payment estimate.
term_months.title: Term Months

zip.description: Shopper's five-digit ZIP, the center of the search area.
zip.title: Zip

name: save_search
